title: How Many Queens to BEAT Magnus?
summary: King plus N queens (no pawns) vs the Magnus bot's full army, starting with one queen and adding one per loss ('for the integrity of the science'). Magnus repeatedly pins and traps queens; with five queens he sacrifices to draw the king out and mates with queens on the 8th rank - 'it only took us five queens'.
rules: Player (White): king + N queens only. Magnus: full army.
Start N=1; add one queen after each loss.

opponent.name: Magnus (chess.com bot)
opponent.avatar_description: Small photo-style avatar; remake as original cartoon GM.

setup: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/8/3QK3 w kq - 0 1 for game 1; extra queens on the back rank each game.
current_impl_issues: Legacy kingplus Q vs Magnus matches; target 5 queens.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'taking on the Magna spot and finding out how many queens we need to beat it... I'll start with one Queen and then add one Queen each game'; 15:00 'check check and mate all right nice it only took us five Queens to beat the Magnus spot'.
